criteria.rationale: Reviewer Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude/Anthropic), the same vendor as the implementer: there is NO vendor separation, only separate execution and context, because Codex is unavailable (usage limit until 2026-10-24). Identity and separation are declared, not authenticated; pose-dist attestations are unsigned. Verified: R12-F01 fixed (unreadable policy of today counts as adopted; a proven-missing policy with a cut in the working tree counts as adopted). Residual assumption recorded as finding b38-r13-l20.
No concurrency contract changed in the r12 fix; go test -race over the release, snapshot, archive and review regression tests passes at 07e77f89.
CLI, JSON and MCP release status shapes unchanged; ErrReleasePolicyMissing wraps the same message text as before, so consumers that print the error see identical output.

Corrupt policy, lost policy link and deleted policy with a cut each keep the governed tag listed (TestR12LostPolicyOfTodayDoesNotMakeTheProjectLookUnadopted); five adoption mutants and three R11 mutants re-run independently were killed by assertion.

Consumers of GetReleaseStatus (release status, open-next, MCP pose_release_status, obligations, releases index, public-claims) inspected; open-next still refuses in every probed variant, and the checker witness stays the stricter gate.
Gaps name the tag and cause; policy read failures are reported by the checker with their cause; strict pose check SUCCESS with 30 pre-existing warnings.
Status lists more tags (conservative) only when today's policy is unreadable or proven gone with a witness; a readable policy that never adopted keeps the R11 behaviour. No public contract change.
Global strict validate 140/140 and pose-mcp 137/137 at 07e77f89, go vet and full go test pass, recorded mutations 90/90 killed.

D1 (recompose projections from the sealed cut and verify the snapshot in the tag tree) is what the release checker and status implement; the r12 fix addresses the material cause (adoption predicate reading a failed load as never adopted) for unreadable policies and for a deleted policy with a worktree cut.
POSE.md, locales and scaffold copies stay in sync (scaffold/distpolicy tests pass); the spec Final Report is updated at closeout with the review, follow-ups and vendor non-separation.

A lost or unreadable policy keeps tags visible with gaps and open-next refusing; the checker names the witness. Remaining divergence (status ignores the manifest-of-another-tag witness) only hides an advisory obligation while pose check fails; recorded as b38-r13-l20.
R1-R8 trace to the registered integration check and named tests; R3/R7 regressions from R11/R12 covered and mutation-killed.

artifact-check --strict: 47 claims, 78 observed, exit 0; orphan warnings are repository-wide and pre-existing. The r12 fix touches only release_lifecycle.go, its regression test and the mutation corpus.
Read-only verification: no tag moved, no manifest, notes or archive rewritten; no secrets; no policy or issuer pin changed by the reviewer.
The r12 fix is a small local predicate change with a sentinel error; unifying it with governedReleaseWitness is deferred as a low follow-up because no gate approves wrongly in the residual case.
